AuthEnabled.description_en: The switch for ZooKeeper SASL-based forced identity authentication
AuthEnabled.description_zh: ZooKeeper sasl 强制身份认证开关
AuthEnabled.title_en: ZooKeeper sasl 强制身份认证开关
AuthEnabled.title_zh: ZooKeeper sasl 强制身份认证开关

ConfigAuthEnabled.description_en:
The Nacos configuration. This parameter indicates whether RAM authentication is enabled for the configuration center. Valid values:

`true`: enabled

`false`: disabled
ConfigAuthEnabled.description_zh:
nacos配置，是否开启配置中心ram鉴权，取值如下：
`true`：生效
`false`：未生效

ConfigAuthSupported.description_en:
The Nacos configuration. This parameter indicates whether the configuration center of the current cluster supports RAM authentication. Valid values:

`true`: supported

`false`: not supported
ConfigAuthSupported.description_zh:
nacos配置，当前集群的配置中心是否支持RAM鉴权，取值如下：
`true`：支持
`false`：不支持

ConfigContentLimit.description_en: The maximum size of the content of a single configuration. Unit: KB
ConfigContentLimit.description_zh: 单个配置的配置内容大小上限（单位：KB）

ConfigSecretEnabled.description_en:
The Nacos configuration. This parameter indicates whether configuration encryption is enabled for the cluster. Valid values:

`true`: enabled

`false`: disabled
ConfigSecretEnabled.description_zh:
nacos配置，当前集群是否开启配置中心配置加密，取值如下：
`true`：开启
`false`：未开启

ConfigSecretSupported.description_en:
The Nacos configuration. This parameter indicates whether the cluster supports configuration encryption. Valid values:

`true`: supported

`false`: not supported
ConfigSecretSupported.description_zh:
nacos配置，当前集群是否支持配置中心配置加密，取值如下：
`true`：支持
`false`：不支持

ConsoleUIEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether to enable the Nacos open source console

Enable4lw.description_en: Specifies whether to enable the four-letter words command

EurekaSupported.description_en: Specifies whether to enable port 8761 for access to the Eureka protocol. If you disable this port, applications cannot use the Eureka protocol for service registration and discovery
EurekaSupported.description_zh: 是否打开Eureka协议的访问端口8761。关闭此端口，应用将无法使用Eureka协议进行服务注册发现

ExtendedTypesEnable.description_en: The ZooKeeper parameter that specifies whether to enable the TTL configuration

InitLimit.description_en: The ZooKeeper configuration. This parameter indicates the maximum connection duration of an instance. Unit: seconds
InitLimit.description_zh: zookeeper配置，实例最长连接时间，单位：秒

JuteMaxbuffer.description_en: The ZooKeeper configuration. This parameter indicates the maximum data size of each node. Unit: bytes
JuteMaxbuffer.description_zh: zookeeper配置，每个节点最大数据量，单位：字节

MCPEnabled.description_en:
The Nacos configuration. This parameter indicates whether Mesh Configuration Protocol (MCP) is enabled. Valid values:

`true`: enabled

`false`: disabled
MCPEnabled.description_zh:
nacos配置，MCP是否生效，取值如下：
`true`：生效
`false`：不生效

MCPSupported.description_en:
The Nacos configuration. This parameter indicates whether MCP is supported. Valid values:

`true`: supported

`false`: not supported
MCPSupported.description_zh:
nacos配置，MCP是否支持，取值如下：
`true`：支持
`false`：不支持

MaxClientCnxns.description_en:
The ZooKeeper configuration. This parameter indicates the number of connections between a client and a server.
If this parameter is set to 0, no limit is imposed.
MaxClientCnxns.description_zh:
zookeeper配置，单个客户端与单台服务器之间的连接数。  
如果设置为0，表示不作任何限制

MaxSessionTimeout.description_en: The ZooKeeper configuration. This parameter indicates the maximum timeout duration

MinSessionTimeout.description_en: The ZooKeeper configuration. This parameter indicates the minimum timeout duration

NamingAuthEnabled.description_en:
The Nacos configuration. This parameter indicates whether RAM authentication is enabled for the service registry. Valid values:

`true`: enabled

`false`: disabled
NamingAuthEnabled.description_zh:
nacos配置，是否开启注册中心ram鉴权：
`true`：开启
`false`：关闭

NamingAuthSupported.description_en:
The Nacos configuration. This parameter indicates whether the cluster supports RAM authentication for services. Valid values:

`true`: supported

`false`: not supported
NamingAuthSupported.description_zh:
nacos配置，当前集群是否支持服务RAM鉴权，取值如下：
`true`：支持
`false`：不支持

NamingCreateServiceSupported.description_en:
The Nacos configuration. This parameter indicates whether the cluster supports service creation. Valid values:

`true`: supported

`false`: not supported
NamingCreateServiceSupported.description_zh:
nacos配置，当前集群是否支持创建服务，取值如下：
`true`：支持
`false`：不支持

OpenSuperAcl.description_en:
The ZooKeeper configuration. This parameter indicates whether the super permission is enabled. Valid values:

`true`: enabled

`false`: disabled
OpenSuperAcl.description_zh:
zookeeper配置，超级权限开关，取值如下：
`true`：打开
`false`：关闭

PassWord.description_en: The password. This parameter is returned only when OpenSuperAcl is set to true
PassWord.description_zh: 用户密码。当OpenSuperAcl为true时，展示此值

RestartFlag.description_en:
Indicates whether the cluster is restarted and the new configuration is applied. Valid values:

`true`: The cluster is restarted.

`false`: The cluster fails to be restarted
RestartFlag.description_zh:
当前集群是否已重启并应用新配置，取值如下：
`true`：重启成功。
`false`：重启失败

SnapshotCount.description_en: The ZooKeeper configuration. This parameter indicates the frequency of generating snapshots

SyncLimit.description_en: The ZooKeeper configuration. This parameter indicates the connection timeout duration of an instance. Unit: seconds
SyncLimit.description_zh: zookeeper配置，实例连接超时时间，单位：秒

TLSEnabled.description_en: MSE Nacos instances of version 2.1.2.1 or later support Transport Layer Security (TLS) encryption. The version of the Nacos client must be 2.2.1 or later. After you enable TLS, the performance may decrease by about 10%. You must evaluate the system capacity. For more information about the operations, see Nacos TLS transport encryption
TLSEnabled.description_zh: MSE Nacos从2.1.2.1版本开始支持TLS传输链路加密，nacos-client需升级至2.2.1及以上版本，开启TLS后，会有10%左右性能下降，请合理评估系统容量水位，操作指引详见Nacos TLS传输加密

TickTime.description_en: The ZooKeeper configuration. This parameter indicates a unit of time in the engine. The default value is 2000. Unit: milliseconds
TickTime.description_zh: zookeeper配置，引擎中的一个时间单元，默认为2000毫秒

UserName.description_en: The username. This parameter is returned only when OpenSuperAcl is set to true
UserName.description_zh: 用户名称。当OpenSuperAcl为true时，展示此值

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

`true`: The request was successful.

`false`: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求结果，取值如下：
`true`：请求成功。
`false`：请求失败
